confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Beijing price levels, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and food anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary more by district and season. The FX observation was taken from a search summary of the RBA overview page, and I could not open the page or the F11.1 table to confirm it directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Chinese mainland price levels for a large capital city, benchmarked against other major East Asian capitals and adjusted down for typical Beijing food and accommodation costs. Drink and cocktail prices are scaled from the local beer price where direct knowledge was weaker.
